# ONIQ

> ONIQ is a global lifestyle super app — one login for messaging, social, food delivery, payments, crypto, AI, weather, rides, travel, and more.

ONIQ brings together everyday tools people already juggle across a dozen apps: chat with friends, send money, order food, book rides, plan trips, check the weather, watch short-form clips, and talk to an AI assistant — all inside one mobile-first, dark-themed interface.
